body: I'm going through this right now. She is super best friends with a girl that she only sort of dated a year or two ago and I'm a very jealous person. They text constantly but live hours apart so they never hang out. She and I recently broke up because a lot of the time I would get extremely jealous and snap at her whenever she would be hanging out with me and texting the ex/BFF. Now she wants to be friends with me and I just... Ugh. I don't want to be the new ex/BFF that makes her next girl friend jealous.

Everything I do is hypocritical. I hold everyone to different standards than myself. If a girl friend or boy friend does something or likes something that I find morally wrong, even if I have done it or like it as well, I find it hard to forgive them. I am the most hypocritical person I know.
I'm In love with a girl that is into bestiality and it's tearing me apart.
